prompts.thicket: Extract the dense green jungle understory plant masses from this reference into ONE self-contained 3D-game-asset concept, isolated on a fully transparent background. A wide, deep, dense asymmetrical tropical thicket about 7 metres wide, 4 metres tall and 4 metres deep, made from a layered mixture of broad pointed emerald leaves, small rounded fern fans, woody branching shrubs, a few climbing vines and curled young lime-green leaves. No red leaves, no flowers, no palm trunk, no tall canopy tree, no path or landscape. Vegetation must be opaque and densely filled from the irregular mossy root base to its top, not a few isolated leaves. Give it real rounded volume, irregular projecting fronds, deep dark green interior and yellow-green upper surfaces. Same hand-painted stylized low-poly adventure-game art direction, broad clean color regions, soft painted shading, readable medium leaf scale, detailed good textures without grain, no photorealism. Three-quarter frontal object view, full complete silhouette inside the canvas with 8 percent transparent gutters on every side; no clipped leaves or cut-off base. Soft even studio illumination only, no floor plane or cast shadow. A coherent reusable Meshy image-to-3D reference, one single plant formation.
prompts.understory: Transform the bush-enclosed jungle from the reference into a wide horizontal isolated mid-distance scenery matte layer for a 3D game. Fully transparent background. One continuous dense irregular silhouette of lush tropical forest: tangled leafy shrubs fill the entire lower half, slender twisting partly-hidden trees and drooping broad-leaf canopy fill the middle and upper half, a few hanging vines. The thicket is densely opaque inside its organic silhouette, NO open meadow, NO central path, NO holes through the lower shrub layer, no separate widely spaced trees. The foliage must read at several depths with dark olive-emerald foreground shrubs, muted moss-green crowns and subdued cool forest-green inner leaves. Match the reference's sophisticated painted adventure-game style and pointed leaf groups, with soft diffuse light and modest contrast so it can sit behind actual 3D plants. No buildings, water, mountains, boulders, red leaves or sky painted into the image. Whole irregular lower root silhouette and all side/top leaves contained inside frame with an 8 percent transparent gutter on every side. Extra-wide landscape aspect about 3:1, thicket occupies 84 percent of image width and 80 percent height. Avoid any rectangular cut edge, isolated tree islands, flat platform or black/white backdrop. This is a complete organic cutout forest wall for overlapping scenery layers.
prompts.bough: Extract an overhead tree-bough foliage module from the supplied jungle reference, for a low-poly 3D adventure game. ONE large asymmetrical twisting horizontal branch with a thick attachment stub at the far left, two arched tapering ochre-brown limbs sweeping to the right, dense overlapping crowns of small-to-medium drooping pointed emerald leaves above and around it, and three hanging leafy vines below. Complete self-contained volumetric asset, broad and shallow: about 13m wide, 5m tall, 6m deep. Same refined hand-painted stylized jungle aesthetic as the reference, varied dark green interior, moss-green midtones and warm yellow-green upper tips; delicate varied leaf groups, no red leaves, no giant banana paddles, no opaque dome or solid geometric blobs. The woody branch must remain visible through some foliage and have plausible load-bearing forks, the right ends must taper naturally. Soft even lighting, no cast shadow, no environment, no landscape, no ground, no glow, no vignette, no backdrop color. Fully transparent empty background around the entire object. Full silhouette contained with clear 10 percent transparent margins on all sides, nothing touching frame edges. A three-quarter frontal object portrait suitable for Meshy image-to-3D, isolated complete branch formation.
